summary: SERDs (selective estrogen receptor degraders) have historically been defined by their ability to bind and promote degradation of ERα (estrogen receptor alpha). SERDs were proposed to inhibit ERα signaling through receptor antagonism and degradation. Consequently, ERα degradation has long been considered a primary mechanism underlying therapeutic activity.
